summary_zh: 1948 年伍德兰德与西尔弗在费城构思光学条形码，1952 年获专利；1974 年俄亥俄州特洛伊超市完成首次商用扫描，彻底重塑了全球零售结算与仓储物流。
summary_en: Conceived in 1948 by Woodland and Silver and patented in 1952, the barcode had its first commercial checkout scan in 1974 in Troy, Ohio, fundamentally transforming retail logistics worldwide.
